positions.title: Startup Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack engineer. Rails, Mobile, JS, devops
* Built machine learning data pipeline to process driving telematics data
* Ported iOS application from Swift to React Native which drastically improved developer productivity and reduced time-to-market
* Mentored apprentice in software development fundamentals

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
As a member of a very small team, I played a key role in the growth of Braintree
from a small development team of 8 to 40 and an application grew from supporting
thousands to millions of requests per day.
• Wore many hats doing everything from racking servers in the datacenter, deliv-
ering features, to answering support emails.
• Primary responsibility was shepherding the architecture to meet explosive growth
and huge spikes in traﬃc.
• Software development primarily in Ruby, also Python and Clojure

positions.title: Lead Consultant
positions.description:
At ThoughtWorks, I proved myself as a leader and as someone who can deliver diﬃ-
cult projects on time and on budget. My time was split between managing teams and
writing code.
• Led a team of 35 developers delivering one of the world’s largest auto auctions.
Played a critical role in improving application performance using techniques such
as caching, background tasks, and query optimization.
• Designed and built an elastic continuous integration cluster on Amazon EC2 that
saved the client 70% of their operational expenses.
• Led teams made up of oﬀshore and onshore developers.
• Delivered a signup application featuring A/B split and multivariate tests to con-
tinuously improve conversion rates.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
My tenure at McKesson started with an internship during my last semester of col-
lege which led to a full-time position. I was able to quickly move up the ranks and
prove myself capable of handling responsibility.
• Maintained legacy system written in T-SQL stored procedures.
• Designed an implemented a complete replatform of the existing system in C#.
